title: TIKTOKS that have me in TEARS [Try Not To Laugh TikTok 7]
description:
WELCOME, to another TRY NOT TO LAUGH: TIKTOK EDITION. It's been almost two years since the last one so let's see who will get the dub this time!
Instagram ► http://instagram.com/coryxkenshin
Tiktok ► https://www.tiktok.com/@notcoryxkenshin

Music:
https://www.youtube.com/user/myuuji
https://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/music.html

Jesus said to love one another and that we should be servants to each other, so I would ask that you all do that in the comment section. Be respectful. We are a community. That means more to me than anything. Thank you.

~CK

comments.text:
Hey Cory.

I know this may seem off topic, or kind of strange to say out of nowhere, but I just wanted to say that discovering your channel has saved my life. I found it a couple years ago, via a friend so thanks to him too lol, and I’ve been an avid fan ever since. You’re a massive inspiration to keep pushing in life, and frankly you saved my life actually. I was in a really dark place, and was about to consider the bad way out when I saw your video on Etika. I realized that I shouldn’t do it, and that there is SO much more to live for in life. I eventually turned my life to Christ, which was the greatest decision ever. I got baptized, I got help, fought my demons, and I eventually wasn’t depressed anymore. So, I just wanted to say thank you for everything that you do. No matter how long it takes for you to come back lol.

Love ya man.
